senses.definition: value (for taxation), tax (from עֵרֶךְ 2);—Pf. 3 ms. הֶעֱרִיךְ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ 2 K 23:35; in P, וְהֶע׳ consec., c. acc. pers. Lv 27:8, 12 c. sf. v 14; Impf. יַעֲרִיךְ v 14; sf. יַעֲרִכֶנּוּ v 8.
